text_block_list.text:
This summer training camp is the perfect opportunity
to grow in preparation for the Kikuka Sho.

"Normally, I would want her to focus entirely on training
and steadily build up her strength, but—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone seems in top shape. Catch your breath,
and we'll move on to 200m dashes next.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-kun. If I may be so bold,
I am currently supervising their voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They don't have a Trainer yet.
So I figured I could lend them a hand.
She could certainly guide her better than the average trainer. However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You look like you want to ask if my own training is going to be okay.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I intend to follow
the training regimen you set up for me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "I've factored that time allocation into my calculations. Factoring in a buffer just in case of unexpected situations, of course."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, is there anything else on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Now then, break time is over.
Back to training.
Furthermore, after that, I spotted Symboli Rudolf mentoring her juniors after finishing her training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—I've heard about it from Hishi Amazon.
That she's in agony over not getting results in the mock races.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If only I had run with the time I got in practice,
I could've won...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: From what I've heard, the issue seems clear enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: First, as a premise, it's rare for practice results to be reflected directly in race results.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Everyone builds up race experience to bridge that gap.
What you girls lack right now is experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With that understanding in place, let me offer what advice I can right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Could you run with me right now,
as a test?"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
...!
Of course!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Shall we get ready, then?
Even when night fell and most Umamusume were enjoying their free time—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about this, President.
Dragging you into our work and all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Think nothing of it. Any problem concerning the academy is my problem.
Do not worry."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "If anything, it'd feel lonelier not being there for everyone's big moment."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's just like the President.
Well then, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—To search for hard-working pony-chans
who've been overworking themselves!

...I know Symboli Rudolf manages herself
without any issues.
Worrying any further is probably unnecessary, but...
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Getting straight to the point, may I ask for your opinion?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I was hoping to set up some opportunities
to further hone our skills during this training camp, you see.
choice_data_list: You mean outside of the training plan?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right. It'll be added on top, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: After spending these past few days, I felt that further growth would be essential to break through the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, aside from the training options we currently have,
is there any other good approach?

I admire her stoicism,
but I can't recommend training any harder than this.
Here, I should……
choice_data_list: Let's eat a lot and build up our strength!
Try holding back on training once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "...I intended to convey that further training was in order... but was my phrasing a bit too roundabout?"
choice_data_list: Eating is also an important part of training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I understand the importance of that.
However, isn't that beside your true intention?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Any more training than this would be bad for you.
That is what you are thinking, yes?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Both you and Air Groove worry about me too much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've shared my dream with both of them.
Along with the extraordinary effort required to achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I order myself to surpass my limits.
I thought you of all people would understand, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Do I appear so frail
that you think something of this level could bring me down?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, that was a foolish thing to say.
I was merely taking my frustration out on you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's simply a matter of me becoming stronger
so that nobody has to worry about me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wait.
Let me think about what comes next on my own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll take your advice for now.
Perhaps I'll treat myself to a lavish feast tonight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then...
I'm sorry about that.
"...Those parting words she left behind as she walked away were so dignified, it seemed to reject any encouragement or consolation—"
I couldn't say a single word...
